segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Good morning. MIC House Agency.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Good morning. I'm ringing about the problems I've been having with my apartment.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Yes, of course. If I can just take a few details first... What's your name?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Paul Smiley.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: How do you spell that?

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: OK, and what's the address?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Apartment 2, 16 Rose Lane.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Rose Lane... and that's in ... ?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: In Newton.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Oh yes, I know the property. Could I just ask how long is the lease?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: It's for one year.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: And you moved in . . . ?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Last week, on 27th June.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Fine, thank you.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: And what are the problems that you've been having?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Well, no one thing is really dangerous or anything, but you know, it's just been building up.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Yes, of course.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Well the first thing is the washing machine. It's been leaking a little and it's beginning to get worse. Because we have a small child, we really need to get that done straight away.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: OK... that's a washing machine for immediate repair.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: And then there's a niggling problem with the cooker...

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Ah ha...

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: The door's broken.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Right.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: It's nothing serious and it can be used, but if you can send someone over in the next couple of weeks or so that'd be great.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Fine, I've got that.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Then we are worried about all the windows.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Are they broken?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: No, but there are no locks on them ... and you know with the insurance these days...

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: And when would you like those done?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Oh, that's not really urgent . . . but you never know when there's going to be a b r e a k - i n . . .

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: No, we'll get those done for you next week, don't worry.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: And then there's the bathroom light . . it's getting quite annoying. It flickers quite badly and it's giving me headaches. I'd really like to get that replaced right away.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: That's no problem.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: And then the last thing on the list is the kitchen curtains. They're torn.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Oh, right. We do have quite a few spare ones in stock and can get those to you in the next week, if that's alright with you?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Yes, that'd be fine.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Anything else?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: No, that's all.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: OK, fine. What we'll do is get someone over to you this afternoon, if you're in.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Well, I'm going to be out for a short time.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Well you tell us your preferred times.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Well the best time is about 1.00.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: I'll have to check that with him. And if he can't make it then, what would be your second preference?

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Any time up to 5 pm would be fine.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: OK, I've made a note of that.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Great, well thanks very much for your help.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: That's fine. Thank you for calling.

segments.speaker: PAUL
segments.en: Goodbye.

segments.speaker: AGENT
segments.en: Goodbye.
